The service contract mandates a write_file initialization step that creates or refreshes the working file for <RESOURCE>, anchors <REQUEST> to <PATH>, and commits the active session record under <PID>; only after that materialization pass are heading operations accepted by the document pipeline.
Arguments:
- path (string, required)
- content (string, required)
